name: edit_file
description:
- Performs precision string replacement in a file
- Requires an exact match for 'old_string', including whitespace and line endings
- Requires a unique match unless 'allow_multiple' is set; on multiple matches nothing is modified
- Use this tool when you need to make surgical changes to specific parts of a file without rewriting it entirely

path.description: The path to the file to modify.

old_string.description: The exact literal text to replace. Must match exactly, including whitespace and line endings.

new_string.description: The exact literal text to replace 'old_string' with.

allow_multiple.description: Optional: If true, replace all occurrences of 'old_string'. Defaults to false, which requires a unique match.
